question: Gopika Verma, the famous _________ dancer received various awards, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniattam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gopika Varma **is a famous Mohiniyattam dancer who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018**
 
• Here are **some other awards and accolades that Gopika Varma has received:**
 
 
• **Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Award, Kalaimamani, Kalashree, and Nritya Choodamani title.** 
 
 
 
• Gopika Varma was **born in Trivandrum, Kerala on July 11, 1969.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She **trained in Mohiniyattam under several gurus, including Kalyanikutty Amma, Chandrika Kurup, Girija, Sreedevi Rajan, and Kalamandalam Sugandhi**.
 
• She also **studied other aspects of dance, such as Abhinaya and Sopanam music. **
 
• Gopika Varma is** now based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• She is the founder of Kalavardhini, a trust that supports the teaching and promotion of classical dance.
 
• She **also teaches Bharatnatyam at Kalavardhini.**
